function.name: skill
function.description: Search for a skill, or load one. The system prompt lists skills BY NAME ONLY. Pass `find` with keywords to get the matching skills and their one-line descriptions; pass `name` to load that skill's full instructions. Read the instructions before following a skill.

name.description: Skill name from the Skills list — loads its full instructions

find.description: Keywords to search skill names and descriptions, e.g. `screenshot`, `plan quiz`
